data.body_html:
New Year's Eve in Marbella is a spectacle of lights, champagne, and the iconic fireworks over the Mediterranean. But why watch from a crowded beach when you can celebrate on your own private yacht? A Marbella boat rental for New Year's Eve 2025 puts you right on the water, with panoramic views of the bay, the glow of Puerto Banús, and the freedom to toast 2026 in style. Here's everything you need to know to book your spot.

Why Celebrate NYE on a Boat in Marbella?

The fireworks in Marbella are launched from the beach near the marina, creating a dazzling reflection on the water. From a boat, you get an unobstructed view, away from the crowds and noise of the shore. You can anchor in the calm bay, enjoy the show, and then cruise back to Puerto Banús for the after-party. It's a unique way to start the new year, and it's easier to arrange than you think.

Our Fleet for NYE 2025: Options for Every Group

We have 17 boats in our fleet, all departing from Puerto Banús. For NYE, the most popular choices are:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h or €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing as above
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719 for 4h, includes jet ski
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – price on request
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – price on request

If you're a smaller group, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are budget-friendly options. For anything not listed, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

Pricing and Inclusions: What You Pay For

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are the most affordable way to enjoy NYE on the water. At €749 for 2 hours, you can watch the fireworks and cruise the bay, or go all-in with the 8-hour package at €2,299 for a full day of celebration. The Mangusta 80 is a premium option at €4,719 for 4 hours, with a jet ski thrown in for free.

Every charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper (and crew if required)
  • Fuel and insurance
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Safety equipment and life jackets
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden costs

What to Expect on NYE: Timing and Itinerary

Fireworks in Marbella typically start at midnight, but the party begins earlier. We recommend a 4-hour charter from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM. Your skipper will leave Puerto Banús around 10 PM, cruise along the coast to a prime anchoring spot near the beach, and you'll have the best seats in the house. After the fireworks, you can enjoy the nightlife back at the marina.

For a longer celebration, the 8-hour package lets you start at 6 PM, enjoy a sunset cruise, then settle in for the night. You can also add a custom route to Cabopino or Estepona if you want more adventure.

Book Early: NYE Slots Fill Fast

December 31 is the busiest day of the year for boat rentals in Marbella. The small yachts are the first to go, so if you want the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, book by October. For the larger yachts, we recommend securing your date at least 2 months in advance. Use our [contact page](/contact/) to check availability and reserve your boat.

Practical Tips for Your NYE Boat Trip

  • Bring a warm jacket – nights can be cool, even in Marbella (around 15°C).
  • Arrive at Puerto Banús 30 minutes before departure to meet your skipper.
  • Inform us of any dietary requirements for snacks.
  • If you're prone to seasickness, take precautions – the bay is calm, but it's better to be safe.
  • Consider a designated driver for after the charter, or book a taxi in advance.
